# Tech tree

Tech tree nodes unlock items by spending **research points** (earned from kernels — see [Research](/features/research/) in the features section). A node can only be unlocked when its **parent** node is unlocked and the **enabler extension** is learned. Point types: common, hitech, industrial, newtech, nuimqol, pelistal, thelodica.

## Categories

Each category is its own page with the full tree and one page per node.
